title: Code of practice for selection, installation, operation and maintenance of pumps for industrial applications, Part 2: Installation
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10596 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Code of practice for selection, installation, operation and maintenance of pumps for industrial applications, Part 2: Installation.
clause_3_terminology: operation and maintenance of pumps for industrial applications

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
